spec.title: Posture
spec.description: Kubescape configuration scans, modelled on Kubescape's Headlamp plugin: compliance per framework, CIS section, control, resource and namespace, with the Pod Security Standard of each namespace, through kubescape-findings-exporter.

links.title: Vulnerabilities
links.tooltip: CVEs of the running images, for this cluster

options.content: Kubescape scans the cluster's configuration against **frameworks** (CIS, NSA, ...): lists of **controls** (checks). This tab compares the frameworks, the clusters and the namespaces; the **CIS**, **NSA** and **Security** tabs show one framework each (its controls, the resources that fail them, the compliance per namespace), as in Kubescape's Headlamp plugin.

spec.title: Status
spec.description: The posture alerts of this cluster. Amber while PostureRegression fires: resources newly fail a critical or high control since yesterday (a rollout weakened the configuration); the namespaces are listed. Grey when KubescapePostureScanStale or KubescapeCveExporterFailing fires: the scores are not current. Green otherwise. Not narrowed by the namespace selection.

spec.expr: label_replace(max by (namespace) (ALERTS{alertstate="firing", cluster="$cluster", alertname="PostureRegression"}), "namespace", "-", "namespace", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "namespace", "-", "namespace", "")

spec.expression:
WITH rg AS (SELECT namespace FROM A WHERE __value__ > 0), c AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, GROUP_CONCAT(CASE namespace WHEN '-' THEN 'cluster-scoped' ELSE namespace END ORDER BY namespace SEPARATOR ', ') AS names FROM rg), t AS (SELECT (SELECT __value__ FROM H) AS stale, (SELECT __value__ FROM L) AS age), vv AS (SELECT c.*, t.*, CASE WHEN t.stale > 0 OR t.age < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unknown FROM c, t) SELECT CONCAT('
', CASE WHEN unknown = 1 THEN 'Data not current' WHEN n > 0 THEN CONCAT('Regressions: ', n, CASE WHEN n = 1 THEN ' namespace' ELSE ' namespaces' END) ELSE 'No regressions' END, '
', CASE WHEN unknown = 1 THEN 'the posture scan or kubescape-findings-exporter is failing: the scores may be outdated.' WHEN n > 0 THEN CONCAT('newly failing a critical or high control since yesterday: ', names, ' (see New since yesterday)') ELSE 'nothing newly fails a critical or high control since yesterday' END, '
', CASE WHEN age < 0 THEN 'no scan data' WHEN age < 7200 THEN CONCAT('scanned ', CAST(FLOOR(age / 60) AS SIGNED), ' min ago') ELSE CONCAT('scanned ', CAST(FLOOR(age / 3600) AS SIGNED), ' h ago') END, '
') AS Status FROM vv

spec.title: Compliance
spec.description: Score per framework as Kubescape computes it: per control passed / all resources it was evaluated on, averaged over every control of the framework (a control without resources on the cluster counts as 100%).

spec.title: New since yesterday
spec.description: Every resource that fails a critical or high control now but did not fail it at any moment between 48 and 24 hours ago: what PostureRegression alerts on (recording rule kubescape:posture_resource_failed:new). Generated name suffixes (Crossplane provider revisions, Velero kopia Jobs) and node names are ignored in that comparison, so a renamed resource with the same findings is not new. A row disappears after about a day. Click an ID for what the control checks and how to fix it. Not narrowed by the namespace selection.

spec.expr: label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, kind, name, binding, control) (kubescape:posture_resource_failed:new{cluster="$cluster"}), "namespace", "-", "namespace", ""), "binding", "-", "binding", "") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "namespace", "-", "namespace", ""), "kind", "-", "kind", ""), "name", "-", "name", ""), "binding", "-", "binding", ""), "control", "-", "control", "")

spec.expression: SELECT CASE A.namespace WHEN '-' THEN 'cluster-scoped' ELSE A.namespace END AS Namespace, A.kind AS Kind, A.name AS Resource, CASE A.binding WHEN '-' THEN '' ELSE A.binding END AS Binding, CASE B.severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 'Critical' WHEN 'high' THEN 'High' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS Severity, A.control AS ID, COALESCE(B.name, '') AS Control, CASE B.severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 2 WHEN 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS _rank FROM A LEFT JOIN B ON B.control = A.control WHERE A.__value__ > 0 ORDER BY _rank DESC, CASE A.namespace WHEN '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, A.namespace, A.kind, A.name, A.control

spec.title: Namespaces
spec.description: Compliance per namespace for each framework: passed checks / all checks, as Headlamp computes it, with the Pod Security Standard the namespace enforces and warns about. Click a namespace to show only that namespace.

spec.expr: (sum by (namespace, status) (max by (cluster, namespace, control, status) (kubescape_posture_control_resources{cluster="$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!=""}) and on (cluster, control) max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="cis-v1.12.0"}))) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "namespace", "-", "namespace", ""), "status", "-", "status", "")

(sum by (namespace, status) (max by (cluster, namespace, control, status) (kubescape_posture_control_resources{cluster="$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!=""}) and on (cluster, control) max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="NSA"}))) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "namespace", "-", "namespace", ""), "status", "-", "status", "")

(sum by (namespace, status) (max by (cluster, namespace, control, status) (kubescape_posture_control_resources{cluster="$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!=""}) and on (cluster, control) max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="security"}))) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "namespace", "-", "namespace", ""), "status", "-", "status", "")

spec.expression:
SELECT n.namespace AS Namespace, CASE COALESCE(P.label_pod_security_kubernetes_io_enforce, '') WHEN 'privileged' THEN 'privileged' WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'baseline' WHEN 'restricted' THEN 'restricted' ELSE COALESCE(P.label_pod_security_kubernetes_io_enforce, '') END AS `PSS enforce`, CASE COALESCE(P.label_pod_security_kubernetes_io_warn, '') WHEN 'privileged' THEN 'privileged' WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'baseline' WHEN 'restricted' THEN 'restricted' ELSE COALESCE(P.label_pod_security_kubernetes_io_warn, '') END AS `PSS warn`, CASE WHEN Ar.compliance IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('
', CAST(FLOOR(Ar.compliance * 100 + 0.5) AS SIGNED), '%
') END AS `CIS`, CASE WHEN Br.compliance IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('
', CAST(FLOOR(Br.compliance * 100 + 0.5) AS SIGNED), '%
') END AS `NSA`, CASE WHEN Cr.compliance IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('
', CAST(FLOOR(Cr.compliance * 100 + 0.5) AS SIGNED), '%
') END AS `Security` FROM (SELECT DISTINCT namespace FROM (SELECT namespace FROM A WHERE __value__ > 0 UNION ALL SELECT namespace FROM B WHERE __value__ > 0 UNION ALL SELECT namespace FROM C WHERE __value__ > 0) u) n LEFT JOIN P ON P.namespace = n.namespace LEFT JOIN (SELECT namespace, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'passed' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) / SUM(__value__) AS compliance, SUM(__value__) AS checks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM A WHERE __value__ > 0 GROUP BY namespace) Ar ON Ar.namespace = n.namespace LEFT JOIN (SELECT namespace, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'passed' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) / SUM(__value__) AS compliance, SUM(__value__) AS checks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM B WHERE __value__ > 0 GROUP BY namespace) Br ON Br.namespace = n.namespace LEFT JOIN (SELECT namespace, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'passed' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) / SUM(__value__) AS compliance, SUM(__value__) AS checks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM C WHERE __value__ > 0 GROUP BY namespace) Cr ON Cr.namespace = n.namespace ORDER BY n.namespace

spec.title: Frameworks per cluster
spec.description: Score of every framework on every cluster, as Kubescape computes it (Headlamp's Clusters view). Not affected by the cluster and namespace selection.

spec.expression:
SELECT framework AS Framework, cluster, CASE WHEN __value__ IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('
', CAST(FLOOR(__value__ * 100 + 0.5) AS SIGNED), '%
') END AS Score FROM A WHERE framework <> '-' ORDER BY framework, cluster

spec.title: Path to restricted
spec.description: Resources in namespaces that enforce the baseline Pod Security Standard and still fail a control that restricted requires (C-0013, C-0016, C-0046, C-0055, C-0210: non-root, no privilege escalation, capabilities, hardening, seccomp). PSS only warns about these in baseline namespaces: this is the list to work through before a namespace can enforce restricted. Failed controls: how many of those it fails. Independent of the frameworks.

spec.expr: (max by (cluster, namespace, kind, name, control) (kubescape_posture_resource_failed{cluster="$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", control=~"C-0013|C-0016|C-0046|C-0055|C-0210"}) and on (cluster, namespace) kube_namespace_labels{cluster="$cluster", label_pod_security_kubernetes_io_enforce="baseline"}) or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "namespace", "-", "namespace", ""), "kind", "-", "kind", ""), "name", "-", "name", ""), "control", "-", "control", "")

spec.expression:
SELECT f.namespace AS Namespace, f.kind AS Kind, f.name AS Resource,
  COUNT(*) AS `Failed controls`, GROUP_CONCAT(f.control ORDER BY f.control SEPARATOR ', ') AS Controls
FROM (
  SELECT A.namespace, A.kind, A.name, A.control
  FROM A JOIN B ON B.control = A.control WHERE A.__value__ > 0
) f
GROUP BY f.namespace, f.kind, f.name
ORDER BY f.namespace, COUNT(*) DESC, f.kind, f.name

defaults.noValue: Nothing left: the baseline namespaces can enforce restricted

spec.title: Score over time
spec.description: From the posture recording rules.

options.content: **CIS** is a list of Kubescape controls. A **check** is one resource against one control; a failed check is a **configuration issue**. Below: **Controls** (score per control), **Resources** (what fails where) and **Namespaces**. Click a namespace to narrow everything to it.

spec.title: CIS compliance
spec.description: CIS score as Kubescape computes it: per control passed / all resources it was evaluated on, averaged over every control of the framework (a control without resources on the cluster counts as 100%). The whole cluster; not narrowed by the namespace selection.

spec.title: Checks
spec.description: Resources x CIS controls evaluated in the selected namespaces.

spec.expr: sum(sum by (cluster) (max by (cluster, namespace, control, status) (kubescape_posture_control_resources{cluster="$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}) and on (cluster, control) max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="cis-v1.12.0"}))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Configuration issues
spec.description: Failed checks in the selected namespaces.

spec.expr: sum(sum by (cluster) (max by (cluster, namespace, control, status) (kubescape_posture_control_resources{cluster="$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", status="failed"}) and on (cluster, control) max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="cis-v1.12.0"}))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Failed controls
spec.description: CIS controls with at least one failing resource in the selected namespaces.

spec.expr: count(count by (control) (max by (cluster, namespace, kind, name, binding, control) (kubescape_posture_resource_failed{cluster="$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}) and on (cluster, control) max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="cis-v1.12.0"}))) or vector(0)

spec.title: CIS sections
spec.description: Score per section of the CIS benchmark, computed like the framework score. On a managed Kubernetes service the provider runs the control plane, so sections 1-3 have no resources on the cluster and count as 100%, as in Kubescape. 4 Worker Nodes is the score of the nodes (kubelet and node configuration).

defaults.noValue: No section data: needs kubescape-findings-exporter with the sections feed

spec.title: Controls
spec.description: Every CIS control evaluated on resources in the selected namespaces, failing ones first, then by severity. Compliance: passed / all resources the control was evaluated on (skipped ones count as not passed). Controls of the framework without any resource here count as 100% in the score and are not listed. Click an ID for what the control checks and how to fix it.

spec.expr: (sum by (control, status) (max by (cluster, namespace, control, status) (kubescape_posture_control_resources{cluster="$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}) and on (cluster, control) max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="cis-v1.12.0"}))) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "control", "-", "control", ""), "status", "-", "status", "")

max by (control, name, severity) (kubescape_posture_control_info{cluster="$cluster"}) and on (control) max by (control) (max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="cis-v1.12.0"}))

spec.expression:
SELECT CASE B.severity WHEN 'critical' THEN CASE WHEN r.failed > 0 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Critical' END WHEN 'high' THEN CASE WHEN r.failed > 0 THEN 'High' ELSE 'High' END WHEN 'medium' THEN CASE WHEN r.failed > 0 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Medium' END WHEN 'low' THEN CASE WHEN r.failed > 0 THEN 'Low' ELSE 'Low' END ELSE 'Unknown' END AS Severity, B.control AS ID, B.name AS Control, CASE WHEN r.passed / r.total IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('
', CAST(FLOOR(r.passed / r.total * 100 + 0.5) AS SIGNED), '%
') END AS Compliance, r.failed AS Failed, r.passed AS Passed, r.skipped AS Skipped, CASE B.severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS _rank FROM B JOIN ( SELECT control, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'passed' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS passed, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS failed, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'skipped' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS skipped, SUM(__value__) AS total FROM A WHERE __value__ > 0 GROUP BY control ) r ON r.control = B.control ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.failed > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, _rank DESC, r.failed DESC, B.control

spec.title: Resources
spec.description: Every resource in the selected namespaces that fails a CIS control, worst first. Controls: the IDs of the controls it fails, most severe first. PSS enforce: the Pod Security Standard of its namespace; a finding in a privileged namespace is usually deliberate, one in a baseline namespace something to fix or record as an exception. Binding: the role binding that gives an RBAC subject its rights.

spec.expr: (label_replace(label_replace(max by (cluster, namespace, kind, name, binding, control) (kubescape_posture_resource_failed{cluster="$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!=""}) and on (cluster, control) max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="cis-v1.12.0"}), "binding", "-", "binding", ""), "namespace", "-", "namespace", "")) or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "namespace", "-", "namespace", ""), "kind", "-", "kind", ""), "name", "-", "name", ""), "binding", "-", "binding", ""), "control", "-", "control", "")

spec.expression: SELECT f.namespace AS Namespace, CASE COALESCE(MAX(P.label_pod_security_kubernetes_io_enforce), '') WHEN 'privileged' THEN 'privileged' WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'baseline' WHEN 'restricted' THEN 'restricted' ELSE COALESCE(MAX(P.label_pod_security_kubernetes_io_enforce), '') END AS `PSS enforce`, f.kind AS Kind, f.name AS Resource, CASE f.binding WHEN '-' THEN '' ELSE f.binding END AS Binding, CASE CASE MAX(f.r) WHEN 4 THEN 'critical' WHEN 3 THEN 'high' WHEN 2 THEN 'medium' WHEN 1 THEN 'low' END WHEN 'critical' THEN CASE WHEN 1 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Critical' END WHEN 'high' THEN CASE WHEN 1 THEN 'High' ELSE 'High' END WHEN 'medium' THEN CASE WHEN 1 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Medium' END WHEN 'low' THEN CASE WHEN 1 THEN 'Low' ELSE 'Low' END ELSE 'Unknown' END AS Worst, COUNT(*) AS `Failed controls`, GROUP_CONCAT(f.control ORDER BY f.r DESC, f.control SEPARATOR ', ') AS Controls, MAX(f.r) AS _rank FROM ( SELECT A.namespace, A.kind, A.name, A.binding, A.control, CASE B.severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS r FROM A JOIN B ON B.control = A.control WHERE A.__value__ > 0 ) f LEFT JOIN P ON P.namespace = f.namespace GROUP BY f.namespace, f.kind, f.name, f.binding ORDER BY _rank DESC, COUNT(*) DESC, f.namespace, f.kind, f.name

spec.title: Namespaces
spec.description: CIS compliance per namespace: passed checks / all checks (as Headlamp), with the Pod Security Standard the namespace enforces and warns about. Issues: failed checks. Click a namespace to show only that namespace.

spec.expr: (sum by (namespace, status) (max by (cluster, namespace, control, status) (kubescape_posture_control_resources{cluster="$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!=""}) and on (cluster, control) max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="cis-v1.12.0"}))) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "namespace", "-", "namespace", ""), "status", "-", "status", "")

spec.expression:
SELECT n.namespace AS Namespace, CASE COALESCE(P.label_pod_security_kubernetes_io_enforce, '') WHEN 'privileged' THEN 'privileged' WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'baseline' WHEN 'restricted' THEN 'restricted' ELSE COALESCE(P.label_pod_security_kubernetes_io_enforce, '') END AS `PSS enforce`, CASE COALESCE(P.label_pod_security_kubernetes_io_warn, '') WHEN 'privileged' THEN 'privileged' WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'baseline' WHEN 'restricted' THEN 'restricted' ELSE COALESCE(P.label_pod_security_kubernetes_io_warn, '') END AS `PSS warn`, CASE WHEN Ar.compliance IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('
', CAST(FLOOR(Ar.compliance * 100 + 0.5) AS SIGNED), '%
') END AS `Compliance`, Ar.checks AS Checks, Ar.failed AS Issues FROM (SELECT DISTINCT namespace FROM (SELECT namespace FROM A WHERE __value__ > 0) u) n LEFT JOIN P ON P.namespace = n.namespace LEFT JOIN (SELECT namespace, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'passed' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) / SUM(__value__) AS compliance, SUM(__value__) AS checks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM A WHERE __value__ > 0 GROUP BY namespace) Ar ON Ar.namespace = n.namespace ORDER BY Ar.compliance, n.namespace

spec.title: Cluster-wide compliance
spec.description: Passed checks / all checks of the cluster-scoped resources.

spec.expr: sum(sum by (cluster) (max by (cluster, namespace, control, status) (kubescape_posture_control_resources{cluster="$cluster", namespace="", status="passed"}) and on (cluster, control) max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="cis-v1.12.0"}))) / sum(sum by (cluster) (max by (cluster, namespace, control, status) (kubescape_posture_control_resources{cluster="$cluster", namespace=""}) and on (cluster, control) max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="cis-v1.12.0"})))

spec.title: Cluster-scoped resources
spec.description: Cluster-scoped resources that fail a CIS control: nodes (kubelet and node configuration; on a managed Kubernetes service the provider manages the node image, so not every check can be fixed here), cluster roles and cluster role bindings. They have no namespace or Pod Security Standard and are not affected by the namespace selection.

spec.expr: (label_replace(label_replace(max by (cluster, namespace, kind, name, binding, control) (kubescape_posture_resource_failed{cluster="$cluster", namespace=""}) and on (cluster, control) max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="cis-v1.12.0"}), "binding", "-", "binding", ""), "namespace", "-", "namespace", "")) or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "namespace", "-", "namespace", ""), "kind", "-", "kind", ""), "name", "-", "name", ""), "binding", "-", "binding", ""), "control", "-", "control", "")

spec.expression: SELECT f.kind AS Kind, f.name AS Resource, CASE f.binding WHEN '-' THEN '' ELSE f.binding END AS Binding, CASE CASE MAX(f.r) WHEN 4 THEN 'critical' WHEN 3 THEN 'high' WHEN 2 THEN 'medium' WHEN 1 THEN 'low' END WHEN 'critical' THEN CASE WHEN 1 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Critical' END WHEN 'high' THEN CASE WHEN 1 THEN 'High' ELSE 'High' END WHEN 'medium' THEN CASE WHEN 1 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Medium' END WHEN 'low' THEN CASE WHEN 1 THEN 'Low' ELSE 'Low' END ELSE 'Unknown' END AS Worst, COUNT(*) AS `Failed controls`, GROUP_CONCAT(f.control ORDER BY f.r DESC, f.control SEPARATOR ', ') AS Controls, MAX(f.r) AS _rank FROM ( SELECT A.namespace, A.kind, A.name, A.binding, A.control, CASE B.severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS r FROM A JOIN B ON B.control = A.control WHERE A.__value__ > 0 ) f GROUP BY f.kind, f.name, f.binding ORDER BY _rank DESC, COUNT(*) DESC, f.kind, f.name

SELECT n.namespace AS Namespace, CASE COALESCE(P.label_pod_security_kubernetes_io_enforce, '') WHEN 'privileged' THEN 'privileged' WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'baseline' WHEN 'restricted' THEN 'restricted' ELSE COALESCE(P.label_pod_security_kubernetes_io_enforce, '') END AS `PSS enforce`, CASE COALESCE(P.label_pod_security_kubernetes_io_warn, '') WHEN 'privileged' THEN 'privileged' WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'baseline' WHEN 'restricted' THEN 'restricted' ELSE COALESCE(P.label_pod_security_kubernetes_io_warn, '') END AS `PSS warn`, CASE WHEN Ar.compliance IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('
', CAST(FLOOR(Ar.compliance * 100 + 0.5) AS SIGNED), '%
') END AS `Compliance`, Ar.checks AS Checks, Ar.failed AS Issues FROM (SELECT DISTINCT namespace FROM (SELECT namespace FROM A WHERE __value__ > 0) u) n LEFT JOIN P ON P.namespace = n.namespace LEFT JOIN (SELECT namespace, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'passed' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) / SUM(__value__) AS compliance, SUM(__value__) AS checks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM A WHERE __value__ > 0 GROUP BY namespace) Ar ON Ar.namespace = n.namespace ORDER BY Ar.compliance, n.namespace

spec.title: Cluster-wide compliance
spec.description: Passed checks / all checks of the cluster-scoped resources.

spec.expr: sum(sum by (cluster) (max by (cluster, namespace, control, status) (kubescape_posture_control_resources{cluster="$cluster", namespace="", status="passed"}) and on (cluster, control) max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="NSA"}))) / sum(sum by (cluster) (max by (cluster, namespace, control, status) (kubescape_posture_control_resources{cluster="$cluster", namespace=""}) and on (cluster, control) max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="NSA"})))

spec.title: Cluster-scoped resources
spec.description: Cluster-scoped resources that fail a NSA control: nodes (kubelet and node configuration; on a managed Kubernetes service the provider manages the node image, so not every check can be fixed here), cluster roles and cluster role bindings. They have no namespace or Pod Security Standard and are not affected by the namespace selection.

spec.expr: (label_replace(label_replace(max by (cluster, namespace, kind, name, binding, control) (kubescape_posture_resource_failed{cluster="$cluster", namespace=""}) and on (cluster, control) max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="NSA"}), "binding", "-", "binding", ""), "namespace", "-", "namespace", "")) or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "namespace", "-", "namespace", ""), "kind", "-", "kind", ""), "name", "-", "name", ""), "binding", "-", "binding", ""), "control", "-", "control", "")

spec.expression: SELECT f.kind AS Kind, f.name AS Resource, CASE f.binding WHEN '-' THEN '' ELSE f.binding END AS Binding, CASE CASE MAX(f.r) WHEN 4 THEN 'critical' WHEN 3 THEN 'high' WHEN 2 THEN 'medium' WHEN 1 THEN 'low' END WHEN 'critical' THEN CASE WHEN 1 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Critical' END WHEN 'high' THEN CASE WHEN 1 THEN 'High' ELSE 'High' END WHEN 'medium' THEN CASE WHEN 1 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Medium' END WHEN 'low' THEN CASE WHEN 1 THEN 'Low' ELSE 'Low' END ELSE 'Unknown' END AS Worst, COUNT(*) AS `Failed controls`, GROUP_CONCAT(f.control ORDER BY f.r DESC, f.control SEPARATOR ', ') AS Controls, MAX(f.r) AS _rank FROM ( SELECT A.namespace, A.kind, A.name, A.binding, A.control, CASE B.severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS r FROM A JOIN B ON B.control = A.control WHERE A.__value__ > 0 ) f GROUP BY f.kind, f.name, f.binding ORDER BY _rank DESC, COUNT(*) DESC, f.kind, f.name

options.content: **Security** is a list of Kubescape controls. A **check** is one resource against one control; a failed check is a **configuration issue**. Below: **Controls** (score per control), **Resources** (what fails where) and **Namespaces**. Click a namespace to narrow everything to it.

spec.title: Security compliance
spec.description: Security score as Kubescape computes it: per control passed / all resources it was evaluated on, averaged over every control of the framework (a control without resources on the cluster counts as 100%). The whole cluster; not narrowed by the namespace selection.

spec.title: Checks
spec.description: Resources x Security controls evaluated in the selected namespaces.

spec.expr: sum(sum by (cluster) (max by (cluster, namespace, control, status) (kubescape_posture_control_resources{cluster="$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}) and on (cluster, control) max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="security"}))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Configuration issues
spec.description: Failed checks in the selected namespaces.

spec.expr: sum(sum by (cluster) (max by (cluster, namespace, control, status) (kubescape_posture_control_resources{cluster="$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", status="failed"}) and on (cluster, control) max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="security"}))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Failed controls
spec.description: Security controls with at least one failing resource in the selected namespaces.

spec.expr: count(count by (control) (max by (cluster, namespace, kind, name, binding, control) (kubescape_posture_resource_failed{cluster="$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}) and on (cluster, control) max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="security"}))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Controls
spec.description: Every Security control evaluated on resources in the selected namespaces, failing ones first, then by severity. Compliance: passed / all resources the control was evaluated on (skipped ones count as not passed). Controls of the framework without any resource here count as 100% in the score and are not listed. Click an ID for what the control checks and how to fix it.

spec.expr: (sum by (control, status) (max by (cluster, namespace, control, status) (kubescape_posture_control_resources{cluster="$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}) and on (cluster, control) max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="security"}))) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "control", "-", "control", ""), "status", "-", "status", "")

max by (control, name, severity) (kubescape_posture_control_info{cluster="$cluster"}) and on (control) max by (control) (max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="security"}))

spec.expression:
SELECT CASE B.severity WHEN 'critical' THEN CASE WHEN r.failed > 0 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Critical' END WHEN 'high' THEN CASE WHEN r.failed > 0 THEN 'High' ELSE 'High' END WHEN 'medium' THEN CASE WHEN r.failed > 0 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Medium' END WHEN 'low' THEN CASE WHEN r.failed > 0 THEN 'Low' ELSE 'Low' END ELSE 'Unknown' END AS Severity, B.control AS ID, B.name AS Control, CASE WHEN r.passed / r.total IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('
', CAST(FLOOR(r.passed / r.total * 100 + 0.5) AS SIGNED), '%
') END AS Compliance, r.failed AS Failed, r.passed AS Passed, r.skipped AS Skipped, CASE B.severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS _rank FROM B JOIN ( SELECT control, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'passed' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS passed, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS failed, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'skipped' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS skipped, SUM(__value__) AS total FROM A WHERE __value__ > 0 GROUP BY control ) r ON r.control = B.control ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.failed > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, _rank DESC, r.failed DESC, B.control

spec.title: Resources
spec.description: Every resource in the selected namespaces that fails a Security control, worst first. Controls: the IDs of the controls it fails, most severe first. PSS enforce: the Pod Security Standard of its namespace; a finding in a privileged namespace is usually deliberate, one in a baseline namespace something to fix or record as an exception. Binding: the role binding that gives an RBAC subject its rights.

spec.expr: (label_replace(label_replace(max by (cluster, namespace, kind, name, binding, control) (kubescape_posture_resource_failed{cluster="$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!=""}) and on (cluster, control) max by (cluster, control) (kubescape_posture_framework_control{cluster="$cluster", framework="security"}), "binding", "-", "binding", ""), "namespace", "-", "namespace", "")) or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "namespace", "-", "namespace", ""), "kind", "-", "kind", ""), "name", "-", "name", ""), "binding", "-", "binding", ""), "control", "-", "control", "")

spec.expression: SELECT f.namespace AS Namespace, CASE COALESCE(MAX(P.label_pod_security_kubernetes_io_enforce), '') WHEN 'privileged' THEN 'privileged' WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'baseline' WHEN 'restricted' THEN 'restricted' ELSE COALESCE(MAX(P.label_pod_security_kubernetes_io_enforce), '') END AS `PSS enforce`, f.kind AS Kind, f.name AS Resource, CASE f.binding WHEN '-' THEN '' ELSE f.binding END AS Binding, CASE CASE MAX(f.r) WHEN 4 THEN 'critical' WHEN 3 THEN 'high' WHEN 2 THEN 'medium' WHEN 1 THEN 'low' END WHEN 'critical' THEN CASE WHEN 1 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Critical' END WHEN 'high' THEN CASE WHEN 1 THEN 'High' ELSE 'High' END WHEN 'medium' THEN CASE WHEN 1 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Medium' END WHEN 'low' THEN CASE WHEN 1 THEN 'Low' ELSE 'Low' END ELSE 'Unknown' END AS Worst, COUNT(*) AS `Failed controls`, GROUP_CONCAT(f.control ORDER BY f.r DESC, f.control SEPARATOR ', ') AS Controls, MAX(f.r) AS _rank FROM ( SELECT A.namespace, A.kind, A.name, A.binding, A.control, CASE B.severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS r FROM A JOIN B ON B.control = A.control WHERE A.__value__ > 0 ) f LEFT JOIN P ON P.namespace = f.namespace GROUP BY f.namespace, f.kind, f.name, f.binding ORDER BY _rank DESC, COUNT(*) DESC, f.namespace, f.kind, f.name

spec.description: Security compliance per namespace: passed checks / all checks (as Headlamp), with the Pod Security Standard the namespace enforces and warns about. Issues: failed checks. Click a namespace to show only that namespace.
